# Updating

The Rust bindings in `src/` are checked in; their headers say they were generated by rust-bindgen 0.65.1. `build.rs`
only compiles the vendored C sources in `llama-cpp/`, so building does not regenerate them. This repository carries no
regeneration script: refresh the bindings by following the upstream llama-cpp-rs process, then review the diff.
For repository-wide change rules see [CONTRIBUTING](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
